个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you authenticate using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

description.zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
description.en: The local ID of the merge request, which is unique to the repository.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. Find the organization ID in the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, if the URL is `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx`, the organization ID is `5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx`.
The ID or full path of the repository.
